verdict.rationale: A desktop operating system could plausibly ship a built-in password and passkey manager, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions password, passkey or credential management. The general privacy statement ('your data belongs to you') is about data ownership, not a credential-management tool, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage passwords and passkeys using a built-in privacy and security tool
